# goslop text fixture — AuthorityTaint enum ranking is not a secret timing compare
lang: python
file: backend/app/policy/vm.py
---
class AuthorityTaint:
    STATIC_REFERENCE = "static"


def rank(candidate, resolution):
    if candidate.authority == AuthorityTaint.STATIC_REFERENCE:
        return resolution
    if resolution.authority == AuthorityTaint.STATIC_REFERENCE:
        return resolution
    return candidate
